svg.title: Yellow Panel
svg.desc: Interpretive vector after actual visual inspection. Approximate contours and vivid screen colors. Individual Chicago component actually viewed in the museum public image preview and downloaded through the ordinary browser. Major corner/curve positions transcribed; wall and cast shadow omitted. Overall bounding aspect uses museum dimensions. Individual panels are distinct from the installation group. Yellow Panel exception: museum reports189.5×212.3cm, but the downloaded installed silhouette is substantially taller than wide (about0.894width/height). Measurement axes/installed orientation remain unresolved; observed shape retained at comparable size only, without stretching it to the reported aspect.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.artic.edu/artworks/152761; inspected 2026-10-27; interpretive study, not a facsimile.
